description: Manage IP-auth whitelisting on a proxy service (Residential Basic, Datacenter, ISP, IPv6, Mobile): add or remove an IP, or list the current entries. A whitelisted machine uses the proxies without username/password — required for the Mobile V2 IP-auth proxy list. Residential Premium/Private use user:pass auth and don't need this.

action.description: What to do with the order's whitelist

country.description: Mobile add: geo targeting for the ports, e.g. 'us'

ip.description: The IP to add/remove (required for add and remove)

ports_count.description: Mobile add: number of ports to allocate

protocol.description: Mobile add: protocol for the allocated ports

sticky.description: Mobile add: keep the same IP per port

ttl.description: Mobile add: sticky session TTL in seconds

name: whitelist_ip
